                        new_rj_end = rj + [x]
                    else:
                        new_rj_end = [x]
                    delta_end = (route_cost(rest_i) + route_cost(new_rj_end)) - (route_cost(ri) + route_cost(rj))
                    if delta_end < best_global_delta:
                        best_global_delta = delta_end
                        best_move = (i, j, side, 1)  # 1 => end
        if best_move is None:
            break
        i, j, side, ins_side = best_move
        # apply
        ri = routes[i]
        x = ri[0] if side == 0 else ri[-1]
        routes[i] = ri[1:] if side == 0 else ri[:-1]
        loads[i] -= demands[x]
        rj = routes[j]
        routes[j] = ([x] + rj) if ins_side == 0 else (rj + [x])
        loads[j] += demands[x]
        if not routes[i]:
            routes.pop(i)
            loads.pop(i)

    # --- deterministic optional merge of adjacent-feasible routes (one sweep) ---
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        n = len(routes)
        best_delta = 0
        best_pair = None
        for i in range(n):
            if not routes[i]:
                continue
            ui = routes[i][-1]
            li = loads[i]
            for j in range(n):
                if i == j or not routes[j]:
                    continue
                if li + loads[j] > capacity:
                    continue
                vj = routes[j][0]
                # full recompute delta for safety
                new_r = routes[i] + routes[j]
                delta = route_cost(new_r) - (route_cost(routes[i]) + route_cost(routes[j]))
                if delta < best_delta:
                    best_delta = delta
                    best_pair = (i, j)
        if best_pair is not None:
            i, j = best_pair
            routes[i] = routes[i] + routes[j]
            loads[i] += loads[j]
            routes.pop(j)
            loads.pop(j)
            changed = True

    return routes
